listen.audio: Hi! My name's Jenny, and I'm from Canada.
This is Carlos. He isn't a doctor. He's a mechanic.
listen.q: Qual é a profissão do Carlos?

listen.audio: Carlos usually wakes up at six, but on Sundays, Max wakes him up at five.
listen.q: Quem acorda o Carlos no domingo?

listen.audio: Rosa hates cooking, so she always orders pizza on Fridays.
listen.q: O que a Rosa faz toda sexta?

listen.audio: The pharmacy? Go straight ahead and turn left. It's next to the bank.
Yesterday was terrible. Jenny worked for twelve hours, and then her car didn't start.
listen.q: O que aconteceu com a Jenny ontem?

listen.audio: So I was walking Max last night, and he saw a cat, pulled really hard, and I ended up in Rosa's garden.
Tony told everybody that Jenny was moving out, but actually, she was just getting a new couch.
listen.q: O que a Jenny estava fazendo de verdade?

repeat.en: Can you help me with this, please?
repeat.pt: Você pode me ajudar com isso, por favor?

repeat.en: What are you doing right now? I'm at work.
repeat.pt: O que você está fazendo agora? Estou no trabalho.

repeat.en: We were at the beach last weekend, and it was amazing.
repeat.pt: A gente estava na praia no fim de semana passado, e foi incrível.

repeat.en: I didn't see your message, so I went to the gym without you.
repeat.pt: Eu não vi a sua mensagem, então fui pra academia sem você.

repeat.en: If you're free tonight, we should totally grab a pizza and watch a movie.
repeat.pt: Se você estiver livre hoje à noite, a gente devia muito comer uma pizza e ver um filme.

answer.audio: What time do you usually wake up?
What are you doing right now?
answer.pt: O que você está fazendo agora?

answer.audio: What did you do last weekend?
answer.pt: O que você fez no fim de semana passado?

answer.audio: What's the funniest thing that happened to you this year?
answer.pt: Qual foi a coisa mais engraçada que aconteceu com você este ano?

answer.audio: What are you gonna do next year, and why?
answer.pt: O que você vai fazer no ano que vem, e por quê?

lines.text: Every Sunday, Carlos makes pancakes for breakfast. But Max loves pancakes too.
lines.pt: Todo domingo, o Carlos faz panquecas no café da manhã. Mas o Max também ama panqueca.

lines.text: Today, Carlos opens the door for Tony, and Max eats everything.
lines.pt: Hoje, o Carlos abre a porta pro Tony, e o Max come tudo.

lines.text: Now Carlos only has coffee, and Max is very happy.
lines.pt: Agora o Carlos só tem café, e o Max está muito feliz.

lines.text: Last Friday, Jenny ordered a new phone. But the delivery guy went to apartment one-oh-one, Tony's place.
lines.pt: Na sexta passada, a Jenny encomendou um celular novo. Mas o entregador foi no apartamento 101, o do Tony.

lines.text: Well, I was sure it was for me!
lines.pt: Bom, eu tinha certeza que era pra mim!

lines.text: Tony used it for two days. Then Rosa saw it and called Jenny.
lines.pt: O Tony usou por dois dias. Aí a Rosa viu e ligou pra Jenny.
